title: Recorded flight-position heatpaths by grid
preferred_scenario: flat / medium flora / f1 / v0 / seed 27 / 8,000 ticks
binning: 5 x 5 grid cells; grid-specific counts share one LogNorm scale across every ideal and camera panel for that grid
measurement: Histogram of actual pos_cell_x/pos_cell_y rows in drones.csv, all drones and ticks. This is drone-position occupancy, not camera FOV coverage.
figure_scope: Single recorded run per available method/region/grid. Not an across-run mean.

exceptions.FOVawareV2: Uses the retained LawnmowerV2 full parity traces, labeled FOV-aware V2 in the requested method list.
exceptions.fullFOV: Retained full_fov examples exist for all grid/region pairs; focus/spread vary across configurations. Each actual scenario is printed in the panel and recorded below, so these are examples rather than a fully matched comparison.
exceptions.targetcell: The target-cell ablation retains configs, but no full-length position CSV; pilot traces are incomplete and excluded.
exceptions.Random: No qualifying recent full-length trace found; older Oct-9 reference traces are excluded.
exceptions.FullyRandom: Full-length validation examples are available for all grids; seeds are G100=40, G200=27, G300=41, and traces use spread v1. The separate figure labels seed/scenario per panel; they are not matched to the preferred f1/v0 cohort.
exceptions.Oracle: No qualifying recent full-length trace found; older Oct-9 reference traces are excluded.
exceptions.camera_examples: Three-ideal and mixed 1-camera panels use accepted production traces on the exact flat/f1/v0 seed-27 scenarios. Four-camera panels use instrumented validation examples on different terrain/focus/spread scenarios by grid and region mode; see panel captions and source records.
